title: SkillInputSchema
description: JSON schema for validating inputs to this skill.

church_name.description: The name of the local church or ministry organization.

theological_tradition.description: Optional doctrinal framework or denomination (e.g., Baptist, Presbyterian, Non-denominational, Methodist, Anglican).

tone.description: Desired tone of voice (e.g., Warm & Informal, Traditional & Reverent, Modern & Engaging).

primary_content.description: The raw text, bullet points, or structured details to process.

special_instructions.description: Any additional constraints, target word counts, or specific guidelines.
